commits.author: Nina-Teskova-Bot
commits.message:
Make sweep failure visible: don't swallow gh pr list errors

The scheduled sweep used mapfile < <(gh pr list ...), which discards the
command's exit status: a failed listing inside the process substitution
leaves prs empty, set -e never trips, and the step silently reports 'no
mergeable PRs'. Capture stdout and exit status so a listing failure fails
the step (and notifies) instead of looking like a no-op.

commits.author: Nina-Teskova-Bot
commits.message:
Fix dependabot auto-merge: robust Merge Ready gate + scheduled sweep

The auto-merge gate picked the last 'Merge Ready' check by start time.
ci.yml runs on both push and pull_request, so the same head commit has two
'Merge Ready' checks: the push run reports it 'skipped' while the
pull_request run reports 'success'. The workflow observed the skipped one
and never enabled auto-merge, leaving every dependabot PR un-merged.

Gate now requires an actual 'success' 'Merge Ready' conclusion (shared
gate script), ignoring the skipped push-run check. Added a scheduled sweep
(every 15 min, plus manual dispatch) that re-checks open dependabot PRs,
so a late-reporting successful check still gets auto-merge enabled.

commits.author: Haydon Ryan
commits.message: Enable dependabot auto-merge gated on Merge Ready check (cf-butler)
